reason: The local provider makes each code single-use by removing it inside its own isValid (services/.../credential/RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialProvider.java:109-111). For a federated user, UserCredentialManager.isValid (model/storage/.../UserCredentialManager.java:66-79) runs the storage provider's validator first, and once that validator accepts the code the local provider never runs. After a valid code, RecoveryAuthnCodesFormAuthenticator.java:80-92 only removes the credential once all codes are used and never removes the code just entered, the new CredentialHelper.createRecoveryCodesCredential and RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential add no javadoc on single use, and the patch's sample BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.isValid accepts any stored code again and again (anyMatch, patch line 354).
